SpaceX entered a binding commitment for a ~$40B master finance lease with an Apollo-managed entity (lessor) covering Nvidia GPU pods and related equipment for AI compute; aggregate scheduled principal payments ~$40B across lease schedules of ~5-5.25 years starting H1 2027 on GPU delivery. Confirmed via SpaceX's own Form 8-K (SEC, filed ~2026-10-24: 'entry into the master finance lease...is subject to certain specified closing conditions and is expected to close prior to year end') and Apollo's own press release (apollo.com, 2026-10-26) naming BlackRock, Goldman Sachs Asset Management, and KKR-advised capital accounts as additional anchor investors (see linked rows) and Goldman Sachs as sole structuring agent. Per Bloomberg/FT reporting, final pricing/interest rate and closing conditions were still being finalized as of late Oct 2026 despite Musk's X post calling it 'closed'; Memphis's Oct 2026 135-day pause on new data-center development is a flagged execution risk. Apollo's own slice of the $40B vs. the full syndicate is not disclosed -- amount_usd left blank, see round_total_usd, to avoid overstating Apollo's own commitment (per CONTEXT.md mistake #3 guard).
